stories.title: Van seized on A55 at Dobshill with no insurance, no MOT and declared off road

stories.title: North Wales Fire and Rescue Authority seeks three members of the public for standards committee
stories.summary: North Wales Fire and Rescue Authority is looking for three members of the public to sit on the committee that oversees how its members behave, with applications closing at noon on Monday. stories.title: Power supply back in Flint
stories.summary: Update, 13:20 22 Nov: SP Energy Networks says power has been restored. Earlier report: Part of Flint is without power this morning after an unplanned power cut, with SP Energy Networks aiming to restore supplies by 3.24pm. stories.title: Mold Food Festival celebrates 20th birthday with top tourism award
stories.summary: A Flintshire food festival celebrated its 20th anniversary in style when it was named as one of the stars of the North Wales visitor industry. stories.title: More than 9,000 journeys made on TfW pay as you go in North Wales in first four weeks
